subtitle: How are you today?
subcopy: One small step is enough. Pause for yourself for a moment.
checkinBody: Note your mood, energy, sleep and symptoms. That helps us match support to you.
epdsBody: A regular EPDS screening helps notice when you need more support.
firstCheckin: Your first check-in will show us where to start.
forecastRainy: A heavy day — go easy on yourself
tipRestMore: Get some sleep if you can. Sleep makes the biggest difference here.
tipLowerExpectations: Drop one thing from your list. The rest can wait.
tipAskCircle: Ask someone for one specific thing today.
tipKeepGoing: Stay the course. What you're doing works.
